All code is base `R`. Every number quoted on the Session 29 slides can be reproduced here.
Data: `LifeCycleSavings` (50 countries) and `chickwts`.

## Full model and interpretation

```{r}
d <- LifeCycleSavings
full <- lm(sr ~ pop15 + pop75 + dpi + ddpi, data = d)
summary(full)
confint(full)["ddpi", ]                  # (0.015, 0.805)
coef(lm(sr ~ pop15, data = d))[2]        # marginal slope -0.223 vs partial -0.461
cor(d$pop15, d$pop75)                    # -0.908
```

## Reading output (Your turn 1)

```{r}
m2 <- lm(sr ~ pop15 + ddpi, data = d)
summary(m2)
confint(m2)["ddpi", ]
predict(m2, data.frame(pop15 = 30, ddpi = 3))   # 10.44
```

## Dummy variable and interaction

```{r}
d$young <- as.numeric(d$pop15 > 35); table(d$young)   # 27 and 23
par1 <- lm(sr ~ ddpi + young, data = d); summary(par1)$coef
int  <- lm(sr ~ ddpi * young, data = d); summary(int)$coef
anova(par1, int)                                      # F = 4.98 on (1, 46), p = 0.031
int2 <- lm(sr ~ ddpi * young, data = d[rownames(d) != "Libya", ])
summary(int2)$coef["ddpi:young", ]                    # p = 0.13 without Libya
```

## ANOVA is a linear model (chickwts)

```{r}
lmc <- lm(weight ~ feed, data = chickwts)
coef(lmc)
anova(lmc)                               # F = 15.37 on (5, 65)
summary(aov(weight ~ feed, data = chickwts))
```

## R-squared, overall F, partial F

```{r}
n <- nrow(d); SST <- sum((d$sr - mean(d$sr))^2); SSE <- deviance(full); p <- 5
c(R2 = 1 - SSE / SST, adjR2 = 1 - (SSE / (n - p)) / (SST / (n - 1)))
F <- ((SST - SSE) / 4) / (SSE / (n - p)); c(F = F, crit = qf(.95, 4, n - p))
small <- lm(sr ~ pop15, data = d)
anova(small, full)                       # F = 2.969, p = 0.042
qf(.95, 3, 45)                           # 2.81
summary(full)$coef["dpi", "t value"]^2   # 0.131: partial F for q = 1
# Your turn 3
1 - (100 / 36) / (400 / 39)                       # 0.729
((300 - 240) / 2) / (240 / 35); qf(.95, 2, 35)    # 4.375 vs 3.267
```

## Multicollinearity

```{r}
x <- model.matrix(full)[, -1]
vif <- sapply(colnames(x), function(j) 1 / (1 - summary(lm(x[, j] ~ x[, -which(colnames(x) == j)]))$r.squared))
round(vif, 2)                            # 5.94 6.63 2.88 1.07
sqrt(vif)
```

## Model selection

```{r}
m3 <- lm(sr ~ pop15 + pop75 + ddpi, data = d)
AIC(small, m2, m3, full)                 # 285.2 281.9 280.3 282.2
BIC(small, m2, m3, full)
step(full)                               # drops dpi (step() uses extractAIC: different constant)
```

## Diagnostics and prediction

```{r}
h <- hatvalues(full); cd <- cooks.distance(full)
c(avg = 5 / n, h_Libya = h["Libya"], maxCook = max(cd))   # 0.10, 0.53, 0.27
summary(update(full, data = d[rownames(d) != "Libya", ]))$coef["ddpi", ]  # 0.61, p = 0.028
nd <- data.frame(pop15 = 35, pop75 = 2, ddpi = 3)
predict(m3, nd, interval = "confidence")   # 9.93 (8.65, 11.20)
predict(m3, nd, interval = "prediction")   # (2.24, 17.61)
```
